references.text: Refers to the same event where the Jews tried to stone Jesus, which the disciples recall in John 11:8.
Describes a previous attempt to stone Jesus, which the disciples refer to when they say 'now they are seeking to stone you'.
Describes Jesus' response to the threat of stoning by withdrawing, confirming the disciples' concern for his safety.
Refers to the ongoing conspiracy among Jewish leaders to kill Jesus, which lies behind the threat of stoning.
Thomas's statement 'Let us also go, that we may die with him' shows the disciples' awareness of the danger of stoning they had just discussed.
